thread:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — SpinLeaf (acct acct_784211) is doing a UK product demo tomorrow and asked for a temporary connection limit bump + IP allowlist on our eu-west-2 edge. Can infra enable for 72h? They expect a short burst of concurrent clients from a partner proxy.

sam_infra: Can you paste the CIDR(s) and the desired conn limit and exact window? Also any rollback criteria?

maria_cs: CIDR: 35.176.128.0/20 (partner proxy). Desired concurrent connection limit: 1200 (current default 200). Window: start 2026-04-05T09:00Z for 72h. Rollback if error rate rises >10% or 5xx > 1% sustained 10m. Renewal note: their contract renews 2026-06-01, AE wants us to track this touchpoint.

devon_se: Suggest adding a canary for 15m at 25% of the increase to watch latency. Also add a model-fallback policy to a cheaper, smaller variant if token latency spikes — avoids client errors.

sam_infra: Ack. I'm going to open a change request and queue the apply with a 15m canary then full roll. I'll include the rollback triggers you listed.

maria_cs: thanks. AE is @leah_ae — pls loop her in once done. Also ask support to prepare quick runbook for the demo team.

sam_infra: Change request created: CR-2026-1182. Planned steps:
- whitelist CIDR 35.176.128.0/20 on eu-west-2 edge
- set conn_limit=1200 for acct_784211 for 72h
- enable 15m canary at conn_limit=500, then ramp to 1200
- attach rollback rule: error_rate>10% OR 5xx>1% for 10m -> auto-revoke and alert #eng-oncall

rlb-bot: Automated note: CR-2026-1182 scheduled at 2026-04-05T08:50Z, approver sam_infra. Audit link: https://internal.redwood/changes/CR-2026-1182

tia_ops: Please add log tag "spinleaf-uk-demo" and set retention to 7d for faster triage. Also enable token-level sampling at 1% during the window for quality checks.

devon_se: Snippet for API patch if helpful:
```
PATCH /v1/customers/acct_784211/limits
{
  "conn_limit": 1200,
  "regions": ["eu-west-2"],
  "whitelist": ["35.176.128.0/20"],
  "meta": {"temporary_until": "2026-04-08T09:00Z", "tag": "spinleaf-uk-demo"}
}
```

sam_infra: Applied canary at 2026-04-05T09:05Z. No errors in first 15m, ramping now. Audit: https://internal.redwood/changes/CR-2026-1182/logs

maria_cs: Great — please ping #customer-success when the change is live and when it's revoked at the end of the window. I'll update SpinLeaf and ensure demo engineers have the runbook.

leah_ae: Thanks team — I'll use this as a positive engagement for renewal convo. I want a short summary (1-2 bullets) of outcomes after the window to include in the renewal playbook.

sam_infra: Will post a post-change summary in this thread 1-2 bullets + links to logs.

rlb-bot: Change CR-2026-1182 completed and auto-revoked at 2026-04-08T09:10Z (auto-revoke triggered by scheduled expiry).

tia_ops: Logs retained under tag "spinleaf-uk-demo" for 7d. Sampled 1% of requests to /v1/generate for QA.

sam_infra: Post-change summary: 1) Demo window ran 2026-04-05T09:05Z -> 2026-04-08T09:10Z; no sustained error spikes, latency increase < 12% at peak. 2) Canary prevented any degradation during ramp. Links: https://internal.redwood/changes/CR-2026-1182/logs & https://internal.redwood/metrics/spinleaf-uk-demo

maria_cs: Perfect — putting this in SpinLeaf's account notes and flagging renewal touch in 6 weeks. :thumbsup:

leah_ae: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the customer and propose Dedicated capacity as part of renewal discussion. :rocket:
